== Honours ==
'''Manchester United'''
* [[Football League First Division]]: [[1964–65 Football League First Division|1964–65]], [[1966–67 Football League First Division|1966–67]]
* [[FA Community Shield|Charity Shield]]: [[1965 FA Charity Shield|1965]], [[1967 FA Charity Shield|1967]]
* [[UEFA Champions League|European Cup]]: [[1968 European Cup Final|1968]]

'''Hibernian'''
* [[East of Scotland Shield]]: 1979–80

'''Northern Ireland'''
*[[British Home Championship]]: [[1963–64 British Home Championship|1964]]<ref>[https://www.irishfa.com/news/2020/april/ni-hall-of-fame-george-best-football-genius NI Hall of Fame: George Best - football genius] Irish Football Association. Monday 20 April 2020</ref>

'''Individual'''
* [[Football League First Division]] top scorer: [[1967–68 in English football|1967–68]]<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablese/engtops.html |title=League Leading Goalscorers |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20181013012652/http://rsssf.com/tablese/engtops.html#English |archivedate=13 October 2018 |accessdate=28 November 2015 }}</ref>
* [[FWA Footballer of the Year]]: [[1967–68 in English football|1967–68]]
* [[Ballon d'Or]]: [[1968 Ballon d'Or|1968]]; third place [[1971 Ballon d'Or|1971]]
*[[FA Cup|FA Cup top scorer]]: [[1972 FA Cup Final|1971–72]]<ref>[https://www.worldfootball.net/competition/co41/se3468/statistics-scorers/ FA Cup 1971/1972 Scorers] WorldFootball.net. Retrieved 5 May 2025</ref>
*''FUWO European Team of the Season'': 1968,<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.fcc-supporters.org/fuwo/files/FUWO%201969/FUWO%201969%2002.pdf |website=FCC-Wiki|title=FUWO 1969|access-date=23 April 2024 }}</ref> 1969<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.fcc-supporters.org/fuwo/files/FUWO%201970/Fuwo%201970%2002.pdf |website=FCC-Wiki|title=FUWO 1970|access-date=23 April 2024 }}</ref>
* ''Rothmans Golden Boots Awards'': 1970, 1971<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.bigsoccer.com/threads/1969-70-british-team-of-the-season.1794502/ |website=BigSoccer |date=31 July 2011 |title=1969-1970 British Team of the Season |access-date=17 April 2024 }}</ref>
*''Sport Ideal European XI'': 1971<ref>{{cite web|url=http://hemeroteca.mundodeportivo.com/preview/1972/01/01/pagina-9/975653/pdf.html |website=Mundo Deportivo|title=Sport 1971|access-date=4 June 2024 }}</ref>
* [[PFA Team of the Year|PFA Team of the Year Second Division]]: [[1976–77 Football League|1977]]
* [[Football League 100 Legends]]: 1998
* Honorary doctorate from [[Queen's University Belfast]]: 2001<ref>{{cite web|url=http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/uk_news/northern_ireland/1709558.stm|title=Best receives honorary degree|date=13 December 2001|access-date=13 May 2016|publisher=BBC|archive-date=11 June 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160611031615/http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/uk_news/northern_ireland/1709558.stm|url-status=live}}</ref>
* [[Freedom of the City|Freeman]] of [[Castlereagh (borough)|Castlereagh]]: 2002<ref>{{cite web|url=http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/uk_news/northern_ireland/4475276.stm|title=Stormont funeral for George Best|date=28 November 2005|access-date=13 May 2016|publisher=BBC|archive-date=4 October 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221004161122/http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/uk_news/northern_ireland/4475276.stm|url-status=live}}</ref>
* Inaugural inductee into the [[English Football Hall of Fame]]: 2002<ref name="HOf">{{cite web |url=http://www.nationalfootballmuseum.com/halloffame/george-best |title=George Best 2002 Hall of Fame |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20160920204015/http://www.nationalfootballmuseum.com/halloffame/george-best |archivedate=20 September 2016 |publisher=National Football Museum |accessdate=25 December 2017 }}</ref>
* [[BBC Sports Personality of the Year Lifetime Achievement Award]]: 2002
* [[UEFA Jubilee Awards]] – [[UEFA Jubilee Awards|Northern Ireland's Golden Player]]: 2003
* [[UEFA Golden Jubilee Poll]]: No. 19<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.uefa.com/newsfiles/171606.pdf|title=Zinedine Zidane voted top player by fans|website=[[UEFA]]|publisher=UEFA|access-date=9 January 2017|archive-date=16 October 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151016100521/https://www.uefa.com/newsfiles/171606.pdf|url-status=live}}</ref>
* [[FIFA 100]] (world's greatest living players: 2004)<ref>{{cite news|url=http://news.bbc.co.uk/sport1/hi/football/3533833.stm|title=Fifa names greatest list|publisher=BBC|date=4 March 2004|access-date=30 April 2018|archive-date=30 April 2012|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120430063848/http://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/3533833.stm|url-status=live}}</ref>
* [[Golden Foot]]: 2005, as [[Golden Foot#Award legends|football legend]]
* [[PFA Merit Award]]: 2006
* [[FWA Tribute Award]]: 2000
* [[English Football Hall of Fame]]: 2002
* [[FIFA Player of the Century]]:
** FIFA internet vote: No. 20
** FIFA Magazine and Grand Jury vote: No. 5
* [[World Soccer Magazine|World Soccer]] The Greatest Players of the 20th century: No. 8<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.rsssf.org/miscellaneous/best-x-players-of-y.html |title=World Soccer: The 100 Greatest Footballers of All Time |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20151231035356/http://www.rsssf.com/miscellaneous/best-x-players-of-y.html#ws100 |archivedate=31 December 2015 |accessdate=28 November 2015 }}</ref>
* [[Ballon d'Or Dream Team]] (Bronze): 2020<ref>{{cite web |title=The other two Ballon d'Or Dream Team XIs: Zidane, Cruyff, Iniesta, Di Stefano... but no Casillas |url=https://www.marca.com/en/football/international-football/2020/12/14/5fd7bc8522601d53598b45b2.html |website=[[MARCA]] |date=15 December 2020 |access-date=15 December 2020 |archive-date=15 December 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201215113120/https://www.marca.com/en/football/international-football/2020/12/14/5fd7bc8522601d53598b45b2.html |url-status=live }}</ref>
